purpose: Fix the acceptance bars for the sparse-split regularization repair BEFORE any variant is scored on held-out data. This is a targeted repair of a reproduced live defect, not model v2: the v2 bake-off (model-v2-bakeoff.json) already rejected wholesale recency weighting on its own bars, and that rejection stands.

reproducedDefect.fixture: Chelsea v Hull City, 2026-09-12, published in soccer/epl/forecasts (matchweek 4)
reproducedDefect.observed: Chelsea home win 2.05%, home lambda floored at 0.05, Hull 56.98%
reproducedDefect.mechanism: lambdasFor treats a 1-2 match split as fully informative. Hull City's away split at the 2026-09-08 fit was ONE match with ZERO goals conceded, so Chelsea's attacking expectation was multiplied by a defensive rate of exactly 0 and only the LAMBDA_FLOOR (0.05) kept it positive. Hull's home split (2 matches, 0 conceded) creates the same class of degeneracy in reverse fixtures.
reproducedDefect.reproduction: fitEplStrength over loadEplCorpus (1550 rows) at cutoff 2026-09-08; lambdasFor(state, 'Chelsea', 'Hull City') => lamHome 0.05, oneXTwo.home 0.020549

candidate.change: ridge shrinkage of each club's attack/defence multiplier toward 1.0 with pseudo-count k, using the EXISTING shrinkK parameter of lambdasFor — (goals + k*mu) / (games + k) / mu. No new arithmetic is introduced; the parameter has existed in the live lib since the v2 research and defaults to 0.
candidate.gridJustification: the identical values already swept on DEVELOPMENT in the v2 bake-off; no new hyperparameter values are invented for this repair
candidate.whyNotOtherFamilies: decay was locked and REJECTED on holdout by the v2 bake-off (B2/B3 failed); Dixon-Coles addresses low-score dependence, not sparse-split degeneracy; manual probability edits, bookmaker copying, and abstention-by-default are all excluded by the operating rules. Shrinkage is the one family whose mechanism directly removes the zero-multiplier failure: a club with k pseudo-matches at league average can never produce a multiplier of 0.

populations.sparseDefinition: a scored fixture is SPARSE when, at its pregame fit, the home club's home-split match count OR the away club's away-split match count is in [1, 4] (weighted count under flat weighting = match count). True cold starts (0 matches, multiplier 1.0 by rule) are NOT sparse — the cold-start rule is not under test.

development.rule: ALL selection of k happens here: locked k = argmin development SPARSE log loss subject to the S2 overall guardrail. Nothing else is consulted.

holdout.disclosure: this season was scored by the v2 bake-off ONCE, for the control and the locked decay:H=240 configuration only — its control-flow discipline means NO shrink configuration has ever been scored on it. It is therefore a first-use holdout for this family; the control's holdout numbers are already known and that is stated rather than hidden. The registered forward population for any subsequent EPL work remains 2026-27.
holdout.rule: scored once, for the control and the single locked k only, after locking

populations.forward2026_27: the ~30 current-season rows are OBSERVATIONAL ONLY in this evaluation (reported, never gating): n is far too small to gate on and the affected fixtures are the very ones that motivated the repair

primaryMetric: multiclass log loss (H/D/A) over the SPARSE subpopulation

acceptanceBars.statement: locked k's DEVELOPMENT sparse log loss must beat the control's DEVELOPMENT sparse log loss by >= 0.010
locked k's DEVELOPMENT overall log loss must not exceed the control's by more than 0.002
locked k's HOLDOUT (2025-26) sparse log loss must beat the control's holdout sparse log loss (any positive margin — the sparse n is small and the direction is the claim)
locked k's HOLDOUT overall log loss must not exceed the control's (1.045) by more than 0.002
locked k's HOLDOUT overall ECE must not exceed the control's holdout ECE by more than 0.010

with the locked k, no fixture in the full walk-forward NOR the current live slate may produce a strength multiplier of exactly 0 for a club with >= 1 folded match in the relevant split; the Chelsea-Hull lambda must leave the floor (lamHome > 0.05)

onFailure: if any bar fails, shrinkK stays 0 and the recorded original forecast stands; the published outlier is then handled by a bounded suspect-output labeling (state the sparse-input condition beside the number), never by a manual probability edit. The rejection is recorded; bars are not renegotiated.

onSuccess.adoption: build-epl-forecasts and the shadow-run pass the locked shrinkK; EPL_MODEL_ID bumps; ONLY pre-event fixtures are regenerated (matchweek 4 kicks off 2026-09-12+; regeneration on 2026-09-08/09 is a legitimate pre-event revision). All prior dated forecast artifacts and receipts are preserved untouched; graded history keeps the model id it was generated under.
